title: Regulator certificate, version 1
description: A regulator's certificate for one lot. The regulator uploads it to IPFS and then passes its CID and keccak256 content hash to issueCertificate as Batch.certificate. Public plaintext: patients read it on the verify page.

registry.description: Address of the ProvenanceRegistry contract the lot is registered in.

productHash.description: The lot's on-chain Batch.productHash, keccak256(abi.encode(string productCode, string lotNumber)). Repeating it here ties the certificate to the product as well as to the lot id.

certificateNumber.description: The regulator's reference number for this certificate.

issuerName.description: Name of the issuing authority. The authoritative identity is the address in the CertificateIssued event; this is a label for people.

scope.description: What the certificate covers, for example 'Batch release' or 'Cold-chain compliance audit'.

statement.description: The certifying statement in plain language.

validUntil.description: Optional. When the certificate stops being valid. Must be later than issuedAt.

attachments.description: Optional. Supporting files such as an inspection report.
